description.narrative: The programme aims to support Ukraine’s green transition by reducing CO2 emissions and enhancing energy efficiency. This is achieved through the development of annual Ukraine Energy Outlooks to guide long-term energy planning and by modernizing the district heating network, including the utilization of surplus heat. The Ukraine Energy Outlook will provide guidance on how Ukraine can achieve carbon neutrality by 2050 and phase out of coal by 2040. The initiative aims at creating an enabling environment for investment in sustainable energy and strengthened district heating, assisting Ukraine in achieving its energy efficiency, renewable energy, and energy independence targets and modernising district heating.

title.narrative: Capacity developed in district heating planning and modernization at national level to realise benefits of sector coupling and energy system efficiency.

MinRegion has modernised district heating regulation and guidelines with focus on sector coupling and energy system efficiency.
Stakeholders aware of benefits of district heating for energy system and opportunities for sector coupling through capacity development workshops and quantitative analyses.

target.value: Workshops for MinRegion specialists to identify regulatory gaps/challenges for modernisation of DH (at national level) are conducted including exchange of Danish and international experiences. Inception report on existing regulations, guidelines, gaps and enablers for DH planning and modernization produced and discussed.

actual.value: Workshops for MinRegion specialists to identify regulatory gaps/challenges for modernisation of DH (at national level) are conducted including exchange of Danish and international experiences. Inception report on existing regulations, guidelines, gaps and enablers for DH planning and modernization produced and discussed.

target.value: Stakeholders learned from Danish experiences and steps taken for update of existing regulation to further implementation of system-efficient district heating.
Manual to conduct heat mapping developed.
Workshops identified needs and possibilities for modernization of DH.
District heating considered integral part of national energy system and regulation modernised.

Modelling framework for energy system planning is implemented comparable to international best practice informed by current Danish approaches.
Ukraine Energy Outlook and Technology Catalogues are integrated in policy development and decision making and published on regular basis.

target.value: Robust high quality modelling framework established and used to project energy needs and deliver energy services.

The Energy Modelling Office of the Ministry of Energy of Ukraine is a unit within the Ministry that actively uses the insights from the work-shops into policy development and formulation of strategic energy documents.

title.narrative: Incentive schemes and technology guidelines support uptake of energy efficiency improvements in industry, heat and power generation.

Enhanced and operational national support mechanism for energy efficiency in industry adopted.
Further secondary legislation formulated to support energy efficiency and highly efficient cogeneration, leading to increased investments in energy efficiency in industry.

target.value: National support mechanism for energy efficiency in industry and efficient cogeneration adopted and relevant legislation to stimulate energy efficiency improvements, excess heat utilization and efficient cogeneration formulated.

title.narrative: Through improvement of national regulation, holistic planning capacity and framework conditions for investments, modernization of district heating supported.

Measures taken at institutional level by Ministry for Communities and Territories Development (MinRegion) to improve framework conditions for district heating systems in Ukraine leading to modernization of district heating (DH) systems in pilot projects.
DH regulation further developed through adoption of new guidelines with inspiration from Danish experiences.

target.value: New regulation for modernization of DH systems including use of renewable and local resources, provides more favourable framework conditions for reversing trend of high disconnection rates and for implementation of district heating modernisation projects.
